behavior_constraints: The run command must accept a repeatable --tag key=value flag that attaches arbitrary tags to the experiment result.
Tags must be stored in result metadata with a tag_ prefix, e.g. --tag env=prod stores tag_env=prod.
Multiple tags can be specified on a single run, e.g. --tag env=prod --tag version=1.2.
The list command must accept a --tag key=value flag that filters results to only those whose metadata has tag_<key> equal to <value>.
When no --tag filter is passed to list, listing behavior is unchanged.
The JSON export must include a top-level tags object aggregating all tag metadata without the tag_ prefix, e.g. {"env":"prod","version":"1.2"}.
If there are no tags, the JSON export tags field must be omitted or null.
All existing functionality (run, list, export, verify, audit, compare, seeding, checksums, environment fingerprinting) must continue to work unchanged.
entities.summary: This round adds a repeatable --tag key=value flag to run that stores tag_-prefixed metadata, a --tag filter for list, and a top-level aggregated tags object in JSON export.
